notes: fixed state is EXACT and allocated at capacity (1,048,576 tokens of history), whatever the live length; *_live fields give what live history occupies inside that allocation

the last row of every configuration with an R5 head is the steady state of an endless stream (capacity + 4,096 tokens): the ring has wrapped, one edge block is not live, and the live index is copied before every scan

r6_500m / r6_1b weights and window KV at 2 bytes (bfloat16) are a PROJECTION: this implementation does not decode in bfloat16 on CPU (the chunked ERSA scan's triangular solve has no bfloat16 CPU kernel); descriptors and ERSA state are counted at their float32 CPU widths
r6_500m / r6_1b carry no PLE; the R7 accounting (results/r7/accounting.json) gives PLE tables at that scale
the 28,552-byte figure of K1 retention describes none of these configurations
